requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic model for provider scoring input that includes a list of at least three quality measures.
The system must validate that each input quality measure contains a name, numeric value, and optional normalization metadata.
The system must define a Pydantic model for weight configuration where each measure has an associated fixed numeric weight.
The system must enforce that the sum of all weights equals 1.0 within a tolerance of 0.0001.
The system must define a Pydantic model for the output that includes a composite score and individual measure contributions.
The system must ensure that the output schema is compatible with fields defined in ChatHealthy.Providers.json.
The system must enforce deterministic input validation such that identical inputs always produce identical validated model instances.
The system must reject input payloads with fewer than three quality measures.
The system must reject input payloads where any measure value is null or non-numeric.
The system must reject weight configurations where any weight is negative.
The system must support serialization of input and output models to JSON consistent with existing provider_search_models.py patterns.
The system must ensure that each measure identifier is unique within a single scoring request.
The system must include explicit field typing and validation constraints using Pydantic BaseModel conventions.
The system must raise a validation error when input data contains fields not defined in the schema.
The system must produce a consistent output schema structure regardless of input measure ordering.
